name: Orb · Corona
description: A raymarched SDF shell with volumetric godrays: the space between a sine-warped sphere and a plain one, lit only by light accumulated along each ray as it passes through the hollow (WebGL). Ported from Orbkit shdr-31 — shader by XorDev, non-commercial.
